correctness.rationale: A primitive pair cannot have equal first coordinates since the second component then forces equal second coordinates. Sort first coordinates and set d=x_1−x_0>0, s=x_0+x_1, c=(a−1)/2 and L=(a+1)/2. The second-coordinate equations fix y_0=ax_1 and y_1=ax_0, so 0<d≤1 and the two first-coordinate equations are exactly equivalent to sin(Ls)cos(cd)=0 and d=cos(Ls)sin(cd). For 0<a≤3, |c|≤1 and |sin(cd)|<d (also when c=0), so no primitive cycle. For 3<a<1+2π, 0<cd<π: the central branch requires Ls∈2πZ and c=θ/sin θ with θ=cd, strictly increasing from 1 to infinity; the only other case is cd=π/2, with cos(Ls)=π/(a−1). This gives two distinct side phases per cell above 1+π, coalescing with the central cycle at equality. Translation by (2π/(a+1))(1,a) advances the cell. On the central branch, both step derivatives are J(t) with t=cos θ; the return is J(t)². The monic polynomial λ²−(1+t)λ−at has strict Schur conditions exactly −1/a<t<0 in the claimed range. The product −a cos θ is strictly increasing for θ>π/2; it reaches 1 before θ=2π/3, where c=4π/(3√3)<π. Bisection independently checks a_*≈4.65946370392898. Neither endpoint is an exponential sink. On a noncoalescent side cycle the step cosines are v and −v, and the return has trace 1−v² and determinant −a²v². Its characteristic value at 1 is negative, forcing a real multiplier greater than 1. Finally 1−π/(a−1)=(a−1−π)/π+O((a−1−π)²), which gives the arccos phase splitting and remainder.
residual_risks: One central attracting cycle per translation cell, not a single global orbit. No claim for periods above two, gains a≥1+2π, basins or nonlinear attraction at nonhyperbolic endpoints.

value.rationale: The full real-plane classification per translation cell answers a natural first nonsingleton-orbit question for a previously studied nonlinear map. It separates existence, symmetry splitting and local exponential stability at distinct exact thresholds, reveals that two new side branches cannot be sinks, and supplies an analytic positive-gain benchmark outside the earlier numerical sweep. This is useful beyond a numerical location of a single cycle, without implying global basin or higher-period results.
residual_risks: The value lies in the complete restricted census and exact spectral boundaries, not a claim of broad consequences for chaotic dynamics.
